Payment can be made with a credit card in your name, and you must provide an ID before renting. When you return it, you will be given your ID back.

There are some conditions as we rent expensive products, but these are not a problem at all for those who use them well and return them in good condition.

reviews.author: 恆槱黔
reviews.text: Most FC convenience stores in Korea are conveniently located on street corners, making them very practical for travelers. The store is clean, bright, and the products are well displayed. They sell a variety of snacks, drinks, hot food, and convenience foods, and there are many special flavors that can only be tasted in Korea, so be sure to try them. The checkout is quick and there are staff who speak fluent English, so they are friendly to foreigners. A microwave and water purifier are also provided, allowing you to easily heat food or drink drinks. Prices are a bit higher than larger supermarkets, but considering the 24-hour opening and convenience, it's well worth it. FC convenience stores are not only a place to buy groceries, but also a great place to experience Korean food culture.

reviews.author: DK Kim (sweet)
reviews.text:
This is an area where the atmosphere has changed a lot recently. A few years ago, there were many old shopping malls and motels, but a number of neat officetels have opened up targeting Kyung Hee University students and young office workers nearby. In comparison, there were still few restaurants and cafes, so it was inconvenient, but recently a large and clean store opened, so I visited it.

I ordered galbitang. When I asked about the difference between Wang Galbitang and Nurungji Galbitang, I was told that Wang Galbitang has 3 pieces of ribs, and Nurungji Galbitang has 2 pieces of ribs + Nurungji. Without hesitation, I ordered king rib stew. They are also running a discount event for the first 50 bowls of rib soup on weekdays, and the basic price is 17,000 won. The price of Gangnam Galbitang is reasonable, so it is by no means a cheap restaurant.

The side dishes and food came out quickly, and contrary to my worries, the contents were very substantial. The ribs were boiled well so the bones came off easily. The seasoning was just right and the broth was full of flavor and delicious. There wasn't anything special or special about it, but it was hearty and clean, so I can see why there were a lot of elderly customers as customers. I'm going to try cold noodles next time I visit. It's still a pretty busy store, but I think it'll get busier soon.

reviews.text: I went in because it said 1.5 for college students, but when I finished everything, they said that this was not a college student counseling fee and that it was 30,000 won. If that's the case, why did they put a price tag on it? Are you trying to get a 1.5 by telling students that they need to work hard to prepare for employment? He keeps trying to explain the relationship between the instigators that he doesn't understand, but when he actually tries to ask, he can't even explain it properly. This Chinese character is supposed to be there, but it's not there, so it feels like I'm repeating the same story over 10 times and not even seeing the proper message. Since there is nothing to explain, I keep trying to change the same story a little differently by combining Chinese characters, but it's all obvious. I think I can do this if you give me a book on Myungri. It's much more fun to just install a fortune telling app and you won't be wasting money. I recommend not going.

Talk about how the components of fortune telling are structured.

If you ask a question, do you mean to come back later and talk about it?

Since they provide free steamed cypress or soybean paste stew, it is good to eat with meat. I don't know if it was the owner or a part-time worker, but the staff in charge was so friendly that I think I enjoyed my meal even more.

As a butcher shop, there are a variety of meats and the prices are very reasonable. They also serve lamb, so those who like lamb will be more satisfied.

It seems to be a chain store, but I think I can visit without much worry if I have some paradise money nearby.
